title: hsk9988660/LangChain-AI-Assistant
summary: LangChain-AI-Assistant 是一个基于 LangChain 和 Python 构建的智能 AI 助手，它将大型语言模型（LLMs）与工具、记忆和检索能力集成。该项目展示了如何使用提示工程、链、代理和检索增强生成（RAG）构建生产就绪的 AI 应用程序。，基于模型推理的架构
description: An intelligent AI assistant built with LangChain and Python that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) with tools, memory, and retrieval capabilities. The project demonstrates how to build production-ready AI applications using prompt engineering, chains, agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
